description: The everyday crusher of all trails. This Troy is our most advanced frame yet. But don’t let its Split Pivot design, streamlined profile and internal routing fool you. More than ever, Troy is built to shred. It has an updated geometry with size-specific chainstay lengths and comes stock with mixed wheels. It has more travel (150mm), so you’ll be looking for challenges instead of excuses. And its new ‘shed’ storage compartment in the downtube lets you pack all you need, without the need for a pack. Our quiver killer has a new set of instincts. Take one for a ride and see how far you can push it. You might never come back.
